summary: Compact ultrasonic range-finder module. A small rectangular PCB carries a cylindrical ultrasonic transducer on its front face, and the transducer's axis is perpendicular to the board. A row of 7 solder pads runs along one board edge, and one mounting hole sits near a top corner.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat back face of the PCB, opposite the transducer. It is the likely seating surface when the module is mounted with the screw hole.

notes: The bounding box comes from the stated size (0.870 x 0.785 x 0.645 in = 22.1 x 19.9 x 16.4 mm). The image shows the PCB as the 22.1 x 19.9 face, with the transducer extending along z. No drawing in the images gives dimensions, so the mounting-hole diameter and position are rough estimates from image proportions, and the hole being through is assumed from its plated appearance. The 7 pads along the top edge are not modeled as holes because their size and pitch are not given. The beam-pattern charts show detection lobes only and add no mechanical dimensions.
